name: AO SMITH Intelli UV +
summary: The A.O. Smith Intelli UV+ is a sleek wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm). Equipped with a 5-stage UV + SAPC purification system and India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber , it ensures safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.
intro: A. O. Smith Intelli UV+ is a premium 5-stage UV water purifier designed for municipal water with TDS below 200 ppm. Featuring India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber, SAPC Technology, touch dispensing, LED display, and a 4.5 L food-grade storage tank, it delivers safe, great-tasting drinking water with advanced UV protection.
